launches.title: A1Zap - the social network layer for AI apps
launches.tagline: Starting with campuses - build apps that spread through a unified social graph
launches.body:
<https://youtu.be/XDBbb3vrdL0>

Social networks were built for content. But with AI, people don’t just have to post. They want to build things that engage with others.

A1Zap is a social network where people build things for each other.

On A1Zap, anyone can create AI-powered apps, chatbots, tools, and agents and share them instantly with friends, group chats, campus and their community. Distribution isn’t a separate problem. It’s built in to our platform from day one.

We’re starting with campuses - our founders also spent the last 10 years working on a college based YC company (Forage!) - so we’re kind of experts here.

We’re already seeing this with “Rate My Rent” at UT Austin, group matchmakers at Harvard, and campus maps, events, and tools across universities.

These aren’t posts. They’re things that happen to you.

Our belief is simple: the next generation of social networks won’t be content feeds. They’ll be networks of things people build and share with each other.

If you’re building for your friends, your class, or your community, we’d love to chat with you.

Students - join your campus: <https://www.a1zap.com/>
